name: Compressors
description: Replacement options matched to unit make and capacity.
long_description: The compressor is the heart of every AC: it pressurises refrigerant and drives the cooling cycle. We help match rotary, reciprocating and scroll compressors to your unit's capacity, refrigerant and electrical supply so the replacement runs reliably.

parts.name: Rotary compressors
parts.detail: For split and window ACs, typically up to about 2 TR.

parts.name: Reciprocating compressors
parts.detail: For older and some commercial units.

parts.name: Scroll compressors
parts.detail: For higher-tonnage ductable, package and commercial systems.

parts.name: Inverter (BLDC) compressors
parts.detail: Variable-speed compressors for inverter split ACs.
